summary: Merged plan using the later calls as controlling. Notable updates: configure exact 3–15 month new-lease and 1–15 month renewal terms; use Entrata vanity numbers rather than direct office numbers on websites; upload the privacy policy, likely as a PDF; keep advertised pricing at base rent plus amenities with fees separate for now; disable card payments while retaining ACH; and expand role-based access for Homebody, reporting, maintenance, and centralized operations. Open decisions remain around Homebody Rewards, legacy Credit Builder cleanup, ACH fee treatment, month-to-month premiums, maintenance emergency routing, and detailed property fee schedules.
